lines.t: Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EU) 2025/395 of 24 February 2025 amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine
( Official Journal of the European Union L, 2025/395, 24 February 2025 )
paragraph 3e is replaced by the following:

“3e. By way of derogation from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, the competent authorities may authorise the purchase, import or transfer of goods falling under CN codes 7007, 7019, 8415, 8479, 8481, 8483, 8487, 8504, 8517, 8518, 8525, 8531, 8536, 8537, 8538, 8539, 8542, 8543, 8603, as listed in Annex XXI, or the provision of related technical and financial assistance, under such conditions as they deem appropriate, after having determined that this is necessary for the operation, maintenance or repair of Budapest metro line 3 cars delivered in 2018, in execution of the service life guarantee provided by Metrowagonmash prior to 24 June 2023.”’
